RE: Application of Duke Energy Carolinas, LLC for Adjustment of Rates
and Charges Applicable to Electric Utility Service in North Carolina
Docket No. E-7, Sub 1146
Dear Ms. Jarvis:
On July 27, 2018, the Commission issued its Order Approving Compliance Filing
and Change in Rates in connection with the referenced matter. Since that time and after
consultation with the Public Staff, Duke Energy Carolinas, LLC ("DEC") has identified
changes needed to its Fuel Cost Adjustment Rider (NC) in order for municipal customers
on lighting Schedules GL and PL to remain fuel neutral from the fuel rate changes
otherwise effective August 1, 2018. Accordingly, I enclose a redlined and clean version
of DEC's revised Fuel Cost Adjustment Rider, along with a revised Summary of Rider
Adjustments to reflect these revisions, for filing and approval by the Commission. DEC
will hand deliver five (5) copies of the rate schedules to the Clerk's office tomorrow.
Thank you for your attention to this matter. If you have any questions, please let
me know.
Lawrence B. Somers
cc: Parties of RecordDuke Energy Carolinas, LLC Electricity No. 4
North Carolina Thirty-Third Revised Leaf No. 60
Superseding North Carolina Thirty-Second Revised Leaf No. 60
FUEL COST ADJUSTMENT RIDER (NC)
APPLICABILITY (North Carolina Only)
Service supplied under the Company’s rate schedules are subject to approved fuel charge adjustments, if any, over or under the
Rate set forth in the approved rate schedules. Adjustments are made pursuant to North Carolina General Statute 62-133.2 and
North Carolina Utilities Commission Rule R8-55 as ordered by the North Carolina Utilities Commission.
BASE FUEL COSTS
Effective August 1, 2018, the Base Fuel Cost established in Docket No. E-7, Sub 1146 are: Residential: -1.7828¢ per kilowatt
hour, General Service/Lighting: -1.9163¢ per kilowatt hour (except rate schedules GL/PL which is 2.3182¢ per kilowatt hour)
and Industrial: -2.0207¢ per kilowatt hour. These amounts are included in the energy charges of the Company’s rate schedules.
FUEL COST ADJUSTMENT AND EXPERIENCE MODIFICATION FACTOR
All service supplied under the Company’s rate schedules is subject to an increment per kilowatt hour as set forth below. This
adjustment is not included in the Rate Schedules of the Company and therefore, must be applied to the bill as calculated under the
applicable rate.
Fuel and Fuel Related Costs
RESIDENTIAL SERVICE August 1, 2018
Adjustment to Residential -0.0000 ¢/kWh
Experience Modification Factor & Interest -0.1081 ¢/kWh
Net Fuel Rider Factor -0.1081 ¢/kWh
Regulatory Fee Multiplier X 1.001402
Fuel Cost Adjustment Factor -0.1083 ¢/kWh
Fuel and Fuel Related Costs
GENERAL SERVICE AND LIGHTING(1) August 1, 2018 Formatted: Superscript
Adjustment to General Service and Lighting -0.0000 ¢/kWh
Experience Modification Factor& Interest -0.0764 ¢/kWh
Net Fuel Rider Factor -0.0764 ¢/kWh
Regulatory Fee Multiplier X 1.001402
Fuel Cost Adjustment Factor -0.0765 ¢/kWh
Fuel and Fuel Related Costs
INDUSTRIAL SERVICE August 1, 2018
Adjustment to Industrial -0.0000 ¢/kWh
Experience Modification Factor & Interest -0.0711 ¢/kWh
Net Fuel Rider Factor -0.0711 ¢/kWh
Regulatory Fee Multiplier X 1.001402
Fuel Cost Adjustment Factor -0.0712 ¢/kWh
(1) The applicable Total Fuel Cost Adjustment Factor for Rate Schedules GL and PL is -0.4790 ¢/kWh. Formatted: List Paragraph, Numbered + Level:

compute the bill. The factors shown below include revenue-related taxes and regulatory fees. More specific information concerning
these Riders is contained in the applicable Rider listed below.
